message: Wishing you godspeed and fruition, Mike.  A few years ago we had long-drawn debacle involving lawyers, a judge and the systematized rhetoric of law.  For me, it was always the problem of shifting agency to a hired rhetor--one who is not necessarily better able to argue the merits of your position but who has formal license to act (speark, write) argumentatively in the presense of the all-powerful judge, a processor who decides fates.
